L_32b820bba7c8.established: Checks primary and secondary functions in eight furnished living-dining types and regresses scores against departure from the Iraqi area standards.
L_32b820bba7c8.how_we_add: We use whole-dwelling activity and access validation to count agreement and disagreement with fixed area rules for each modeled household.

L_792cecda08ce.established: Compresses depth in 0.10 m steps with ergonomic action domains and behavioral adjacency, then screens five equally weighted circulation paths. The study compares free and fixed structural constraints and checks one occupied-unit plan.
L_792cecda08ce.how_we_add: We estimate the same-shell fixed-to-transformable equivalent-area difference using daily household demand, common positions, feasible switching and support-aware inversion.

L_f37afa3aa682.established: Compares estimated activity floor area for fixed and folding furniture in a 12 m² bedroom, including a reported approximately 5–5.5 m² static and 8 m² folded-bed area.
L_f37afa3aa682.how_we_add: R checks the comparison under explicit area definitions. The paired corpus experiment extends the unit of analysis to whole dwellings and daily functional coverage.

L_5392e04d308b.established: The abstract combines activity-area requirements, furniture preferences and anthropometry into a single-person older-adult area recommendation. The index lists access points for the full article.
L_5392e04d308b.how_we_add: We test matched layouts across four household activity schedules. This reference concerns a different population and area-estimation method.

L_0e7513ddedd2.sections: IMJRD version, Methodology, Table 1, Results and Discussion, Conclusion
L_0e7513ddedd2.established: Classifies 84 one-room plans into three typologies, compares dimensions with local requirements and uses AI precedents for conceptual improvements.
L_0e7513ddedd2.how_we_add: We evaluate functional coverage against independent geometry checks and quantify classification disagreement under specified adequacy thresholds.

L_32ba646f90d3.established: Synthesizes European room standards into size, width and access criteria for spaces that can serve multiple functions.
L_32ba646f90d3.how_we_add: We check how actual furniture states and time-indexed activities affect feasible coverage in each fixed shell and derive an equivalent area.

L_ce08fbd6cc33.established: Applies 12 reference indicators to nine Riga plans, including area, dining seats, storage, bath equipment and daylight. The median reference values support qualitative comparison.
L_ce08fbd6cc33.how_we_add: We use an explicit household schedule and independent spatial validator to evaluate task-level coverage and fixed-area classification.

L_6a9ad911d99d.established: Surveys 138 users on current and preferred combinations of room functions and four convertible design features, including folding furniture.
L_6a9ad911d99d.how_we_add: We isolate what can be served by furniture form and switching within a fixed shell, using modeled schedules and computational feasibility checks.
L_6a9ad911d99d.publication_note: Journal issue date 2023. The retrieved metadata year is retained in the ledger.

L_65f4adf27ebb.sections: Institutional project summary and repository record
L_65f4adf27ebb.established: Combines configurational analysis and activity-space profiles with older residents’ experiences and levels of support. The project summary and deposit describe the study, and the original report was unavailable in the checked sources.
L_65f4adf27ebb.how_we_add: We compare fixed floor-area thresholds with validated task coverage in the study households. The older-person evidence motivates extending future requirements to care and access.

L_e5dd101fd616.sections: Thesis chapters 3–4 and conclusion, PDF pp. 41–42, 48–56, 86–87
L_e5dd101fd616.established: Design exploration iterates custom furniture and partitions for a simulated Hong Kong live/shop apartment. The thesis describes 35 m² in its methodology and 45 m² in discussion of design limitations.
L_e5dd101fd616.how_we_add: We use a fixed area range and common dwelling-only scenarios across sampled shells to estimate functional coverage and support-aware area differences.
